summary.headline: Suraksha Diagnostic's transcript is an IPO prospectus, not a Q2 FY27 call; the offer is ₹8,462.49 mn OFS at ₹441/share.
summary.overview: The document supplied is the Dec 3, 2024 IPO prospectus (offer closed Dec 3, 2024), not an earnings or investor call for Q2 FY27 dated 2026-11-13 as the request states. It contains no quarter-two FY27 results, guidance, or management commentary. The offer is a pure offer-for-sale of 19,189,330 shares (₹8,462.49 mn) with no fresh issue, so the company receives no proceeds. Financials cover Q1 FY25 (three months to June 30, 2024) and FY22 to FY24, with FY24 revenue of ₹2,187.09 mn and PAT of ₹231.27 mn.

guidance_outlook: No forward guidance is given in the document; it is a prospectus, not a results call.

Industry context (CRISIL): Indian diagnostics market ₹860–870 bn in FY24 growing at 10–12% CAGR to ₹1,275–1,375 bn by FY28; eastern and north-eastern market 10.5–12.5% CAGR; West Bengal ₹61–63 bn growing to ₹95–100 bn.
capex_capacity: As of June 30, 2024: 49 diagnostic centres, 166 sample collection centres (161 franchised), 8 satellite labs plus central reference lab; 215 touchpoints total.
Machines: 24 CT and 13 MRI units; 13 hub centres; 2 PPP centres.
Capital commitments not provided for: ₹87.69 mn (net of advances) as of June 30, 2024.
demand_pricing: Offer price ₹441/share (floor ₹420, cap ₹441), 220.5x face value; anchor allocation at ₹441.
Competition: market share in East India 1.15–1.30% vs Dr Lal PathLabs 5.30–5.70% in North and Vijaya 2.20–2.50% in South (CRISIL).
Average revenue per centre FY24 ₹45.56 mn vs ₹44.22 mn FY23 and ₹54.44 mn FY22.

qa_highlights.question: No analyst Q&A is present in the document; it is a prospectus, not an earnings or investor call.
qa_highlights.answer: Not applicable. The transcript contains no management responses. The closest disclosures are risk-factor statements, e.g., 95.48% of FY24 revenue from West Bengal and 6.17% from B2B.

qa_highlights.question: What is the offer size and structure?
qa_highlights.answer: Pure offer for sale of 19,189,330 shares at ₹441 (₹8,462.49 mn), with no fresh issue and no proceeds to the company; the offer is 36.84% of post-offer equity capital.

risks_watch: Concentration: 95.48% of FY24 revenue from West Bengal; 206 of 215 centres in that state.
Credit rating cut from BBB+ (2022) to B/Stable (2024) with issuer not cooperating; cost of borrowing risk.
Promoter-group pledges: 40.90% of paid-up capital pledged to Vistra ITCL for Tinni Investments NCDs; non-disposal undertakings cover a further 25.69%.

Governance history: compounding of Companies Act violations, untraceable corporate records, auditor emphasis of matter on a vendor (₹9.58 mn procurement); related-party purchases from R.A. Enterprises (promoter group) at 15.24% of Q1 FY25 supply.
OrbiMed must fall below 25% post-offer (33.35% pre-offer; 12.88% post-offer) or be treated as promoter.
